You adopt a canine aspect, granting you physical traits such as the piercing eyes, sharp nails, and elongated canines.

You gain a darkvision range of 60 feet. If you already possess darkvision, add 60 ft to its range.

Once per turn when you hit a creature that is no more than 1 size larger than you with your natural weapons, you can force the target to make a Strength Saving Throw. On a failure, the target is knocked Prone. The DC for this is 8 + your Proficiency + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice). If the target creature is already Prone, you grapple the creature instead if it fails the save.

Once you reach level 10 in this class, you count as 1 size larger for the purposes of this feature.
